note: Counts of poles per layer (0 to 35) that meet a fixed selectivity rule; positive and negative poles combined.

rules.types: rate on the type at least 0.005 and at least 10 (r10) or 3 (r3) times the rate on all other tokens, with half a count added to the denominator
rules.sections: rate in the section at least 0.005 and at least 3 (r3) or 10 (r10) times the rate in the other five label sections; label_text compares all label text with general web text
rules.classes: at least 50 fires in the class's labels and a lift of at least 3 against all other labels, with half a count added (the flag rule without its cap of 50 poles per class)
